title: A Baseline Assessment for the Agentic Web Technology Stack
abstract: arXiv:2610.13703v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The fast pace in which protocols, frameworks, and technologies are being proposed for LLM-based agents results in a complex scenario for anyone aiming to create state-of-the-art AI solutions. Without an assessment on how different protocols, frameworks, and libraries work together to compose an Agentic Web solution, developers and organizations face different challenges (e.g., skilling, governance, infrastructure) even before becoming part of the Agentic Web ecosystem. In this context, we propose a system for performing Agentic Web evaluations called MASTIF (Multi-Agent System TestIng Framework) and present a baseline assessment of Agentic Web technologies, including 3 LLMs, 3 protocols, and 4 agent implementation frameworks, against 300 Mind2Web benchmark tasks. Results suggest that selecting a task-specific technology stack may result in gains of task completion rate, efficiency score, and social value stability scores; and reductions

translated_title: 智能体网络技术栈的基线评估
translated_abstract: 针对基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体，各类协议、框架和技术正以极快的速度被提出，这给任何旨在创建最先进AI解决方案的人带来了复杂的局面。如果缺乏对不同协议、框架和库如何协同工作以构建智能体网络解决方案的评估，开发者和组织甚至在成为智能体网络生态系统一员之前，就会面临各种挑战（例如技能培养、治理、基础设施等）。在此背景下，我们提出了一个用于执行智能体网络评估的系统，称为MASTIF（多智能体系统测试框架），并针对300个Mind2Web基准任务，对智能体网络技术进行了基线评估，其中包括3个大语言模型、3种协议和4个智能体实现框架。结果表明，选择面向特定任务的技术栈可能会带来任务完成率、效率得分和社会价值稳定性得分的提升，并实现某些方面的降低。
tldr: 本文提出了MASTIF多智能体系统测试框架，对由3个LLM、3种协议和4个智能体实现框架组成的智能体网络技术栈在300个Mind2Web基准任务上进行了基线评估，发现针对特定任务选择技术栈可以提升任务完成率、效率得分和社会价值稳定性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes MASTIF, a Multi-Agent System Testing Framework, and presents a baseline assessment of Agentic Web technology stacks (3 LLMs, 3 protocols, and 4 agent frameworks) on 300 Mind2Web benchmark tasks, showing that selecting a task-specific technology stack can improve task completion rate, efficiency, and social value stability.
